scope: BioBind private profile end to end with real LFW features (InceptionResnetV1 VGGFace2, 512-D, Gamma 512) on local Ganache 7.9.2 (Shanghai), solc 0.8.36+commit.8a079791.Emscripten.clang: MCU packet, R1 bridge, BioZKFHEEnrollmentSourceCompact (t=3 of 5 simulated committee, SCMV L=512), adapter, PrivateAuthGateway (PoseidonT3 trees), auth_private_512 proofs; epsilon 319949

demoSelection.rule:
Export real LFW feature vectors for the 512-D private-circuit demos.

Selection rule (fixed, deterministic; this is a demonstration, not an accuracy
estimate -- accuracy comes from the View 2 protocol in score_and_analyze.py):
  * candidates are identities with >= 3 images among the extracted View 2 images;
  * person A: alphabetically first candidate whose three first images have all
    pairwise cosine similarities >= 0.6 (enrollment, probe, re-enrollment);
  * person B: next candidate with the same property and cosine < 0.2 to A's images.

securityWarning: Simulated committee (PVSC, coverage, threshold decryption not executed and not in gas); software MCU/bridge/AFE keys; benchmark-only Groth16 setup; synthetic vectors; never deploy.
